title: 1993 AMC 8 Problem 8
statement: To control her blood pressure, Jill’s grandmother takes one half of a pill every other day. If one supply of medicine contains \(60\) pills, then the supply of medicine will last approximately

solutions.text:
She takes half a pill every two days, so one pill lasts \(4\) days. Then \(60\) pills last \(60 \times 4 = 240\) days.

At about \(30\) days per month, that is roughly \(240 \div 30 = 8\) months.

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: Half a pill every other day means one whole pill covers \(4\) days
Find the total number of days, then convert to months using about \(30\) days per month
